verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Paxos runs stablecoin infrastructure, but only for its own Paxos-issued coins (USDG, PYUSD, USDP). It documents mint orchestrations (USD to stablecoin), redeem orchestrations (stablecoin to USD to bank), 1:1 USDG redeemability, and monthly reserve-composition and attestation reports. Nothing documents a product that lets a founder issue their own branded stablecoin, so this is only glancing support for the story's core. Missing for 10: a documented branded/white-label issuance product, issuer-side minting and redemption controls for a custom token, reserve management for a client-branded coin, and honestly quoted gating or eligibility requirements.
